name: Hermanubis
desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Hermanubis, the Greatest of Sages. The only one among the Seven Pillars to ascend from humanity to the rank of a god's familiar. Born of the Tighnar people, he was a sage and warrior known far and wide. Sincere, steadfast, kind, and steady, he earned widespread respect. He was the guide of all priests, and within the academic world, he is honored as a foundational figure of desert civilization.

customize.text: Hermanubis was one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret and was highly respected by the other pillars, especially

customize.name: Bennu
customize.desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Bennu, the Most-Radiant. Bennu is an intelligent construct fashioned by King Deshret, who entrusted him with the duty of guarding the gates of Aaru. He possesses a will of his own. He watches over the eternal utopia within Aaru — the Golden Slumber. Following the passing of King Deshret, he ceased his own functions and fell into stillness. Despite being an intelligent construct, Bennu possesses a remarkably vivid personality. Serious and earnest, he detests having his plans disrupted, and has little tolerance for irresponsible colleagues.

customize.name: Shesepankh
customize.desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Shesepankh, the Most-Holy. Shesepankh is an intelligent construct fashioned by King Deshret Al-Ahmar, who entrusted him with the duty of overseeing all the Jinn of the world. Shesepankh possesses a will of his own. Following the passing of King Deshret Al-Ahmar, he ceased his own functions and fell into stillness.

customize.text: . He was the only mortal, so the others mourned his loss. Even now, a millennium later, the mention of his name stirs memories of the days when they once gathered together in fellowship.

customize.name: Temple of Silence
customize.desc: An organization founded by Hermanubis, one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret, along with his followers during the chaotic age of the sea of sand. Its purpose is to protect and regulate the knowledge and technologies left behind by King Deshret's civilization, shielding them from the grasp of those with ill intent. Even after centuries, they continue to uphold this ancient duty.

customize.text: Following the passing of King Deshret, Hermanubis led his people to the city of Tulaytullah, where he founded the Temple of Silence to preserve and steward all manner of knowledge. To safeguard this lofty and hidden order, he shattered himself so that his power might be inherited by those who came after. To this day, the members of the Temple of Silence raise their voices in praise of Hermanubis: May his name endure through the ages, and his valor remain immortal across all time.

customize.name: Sethos
customize.desc: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

customize.text: One of the children from the Temple of Silence, who was implanted with the Ba Fragment, a portion of Hermanubis's power that he left behind for humanity. After his duel with Cyno, Sethos voluntarily gave up his fragment.

customize.name: Cyno
customize.desc: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

customize.text: One of the children from the Temple of Silence, who received the Ba Fragment. After his duel with Sethos, Cyno gained the full power of Hermanubis.

customize.name: Dialogues of the Desert Sages
customize.desc: A caduceus symbolizing the glory of alchemy, made from special alloys to match its special status. It is exceedingly rigid and heavy, and would probably hurt pretty bad if used as a cudgel.
